introduction: CAPK’s Energy Program provides utility assistance and home-efficiency services for qualifying Kern households. Apply using the appropriate program packet.
description: CAPK’s Energy Program provides utility assistance and home-efficiency services for qualifying Kern households. Apply using the appropriate program packet.

sections.who: CAPK checks household income, residence and other requirements. Its posted checklist includes adult age, eligible status and utility documentation.
sections.get: Approved help may address energy bills or assessed efficiency upgrades. These are separate services.
sections.docs:
• Current household income evidence.
  • Valid identification and requested Social Security documentation.
  • Utility bill covering at least 22 billing days.
sections.apply:
1. Download the packet

    Choose utility assistance or weatherization at CAPK forms.

  2. Submit

    Email heapoffice@capk.org or mail/drop off at 300 19th Street, Bakersfield, CA 93301.

  3. Complete review

    Return missing information and explain any shutoff deadline.
sections.after: Confirm payment with CAPK and the utility. An application does not itself halt disconnection.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using CAPK Energy eligibility; Forms and submission. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: Choose the packet for the assistance requested.
Ask about current processing and urgent options.
